rationale: C107 is an aggregate review warning for negative cost rows. The raw Schedule of Investments itself prints negative costs in parentheses in the Cost* column for revolving/undrawn-style positions with no outstanding principal, and the filing separately discloses total unfunded commitments. The extracted negative costs therefore match source presentation rather than showing a data error; the flag is overbroad for source-present negative-cost positions.
